title: Even or Odd
statement:
Decide whether a whole number is even.

The input is one integer `n` on a single line. It can be zero or negative. Print `true` when `n` is even and `false` when it is odd.

Input:

```text
4
```

Expected output:

```text
true
```
hints: A number is even when dividing it by 2 leaves no remainder.
The remainder operator `%` gives you what is left over. Compare it with `==`.

python.solution:
def is_even(n: int) -> bool:
    return n % 2 == 0


n = int(input())
print("true" if is_even(n) else "false")
